fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Open Lawn Area; Detached Structure; Equipment Storage Area; Landscaped Area; Walkway
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Limited Rear Access; Dense Vegetation; Equipment Storage Area
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the road in both directions.
• Keep the rear access point unlocked and clearly marked so responders can locate it quickly.
• Trim vegetation along the path to the rear of the property so responders can move through without obstruction.
• Clear a walkable path around the detached structure wide enough for responders carrying equipment.
• Keep the area in front of the equipment storage area clear so responders can identify and reach stored items without having to move obstacles.
• Mark all access points to the property so responders arriving from any direction can orient quickly.
• Thin dense vegetation near the main residence to allow responders to move along the exterior walls.
• Keep the parking area clear of stored equipment so it can be used as a staging area during an emergency response.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Trees; Tree Cluster; Scattered Shrubs; Vegetation Near Structure; Open Terrain; Multiple Access Routes; Woody Debris; Grass Cover; Adequate Vegetation Separation
wildfire.recommendations:
• Remove woody debris visible near the structure, including fallen branches and accumulated dead material.
• Thin trees within the cluster closest to the structure to create more open space between individual trees.
• Trim shrubs that are growing directly against or immediately next to the structure.
• Clear grass cover close to the structure, keeping it short and sparse in the area immediately surrounding the building.
• Separate scattered shrubs from nearby trees to reduce the connection between low vegetation and tree canopy.
• Remove dead branches from scattered trees near the structure.
• Keep both access routes clear of overhanging branches and encroaching vegetation.
• Clear woody debris from along the driveway and access routes to keep them passable.
